tasks_completed.description: Fix Permission States filter rendering empty content
tasks_completed.changes: Added filterKey parameter "permissions" to all 4 renderExample calls in the permissions block (lines 482-485)
tasks_completed.rationale: renderExample uses effectiveKey = filterKey ?? key. Without filterKey, effectiveKey was "toolPending"/"toolApproved"/etc, which never matches selectedExample="permissions", so all items returned null.

tasks_completed.description: Fix Status Icons filter rendering empty content
tasks_completed.changes: Added filterKey parameter "status" to all 5 renderExample calls in the status block (lines 496-500)
tasks_completed.rationale: Same root cause: effectiveKey was "bashRunning"/"bash"/etc which never matched selectedExample="status", causing all items to return null.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: renderExample() uses effectiveKey = filterKey ?? key to determine which filter a demo item belongs to. The permissions and status blocks called renderExample without passing the filterKey argument, so items used their own key names ("toolPending", "bashRunning", etc.) instead of "permissions" or "status". When those filters were selected, the guard condition (selectedExample !== effectiveKey) rejected every item.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Pass the correct filterKey string as the third argument so effectiveKey resolves to the filter name, allowing items to render when that filter is active.

dev.qa_notes: Navigate to the dev tools2 page. Select the "Permission States" chip — should show 4 demo items (pending, approved, denied, canceled). Select the "Status Icons" chip — should show 5 demo items (running, completed, error, denied, canceled states). Both sections also appear in "All Examples" view (no regression there since the all-examples path uses selectedExample === "all" which bypasses the filterKey check).
